method.distance: mean over ten assets: both absent=0; presence mismatch=1; both present=mean(direction mismatch, abs(log1p(z1)-log1p(z2))/(1+abs(log1p(z1)-log1p(z2))), abs(delay1-delay2)/30)
method.ordering: events ordered by timestamp,event_id; linkage ties by member index tuples; medoid ties earlier event
method.retrieval: compare query with every historical fingerprint censored at the same observed_minutes; no cluster filter
method.interpretation: Temporal association, not causal contagion. Similarities are not probabilities or forecasts.

summary.interpretation: 算法在此次删一检验下通过预先冻结的工程稳定性门槛；单例仍只是一个孤立观察，没有重复类证据。

definitions.ari: Label-invariant contingency-pair adjusted Rand index on common83 items.
definitions.class_matching: One-to-one maximum sum of class Jaccards; absent reference class excluded from assignment and recorded null.
definitions.thresholds: Descriptive engineering checks, not significance tests or predictive validation.
definitions.singleton: Deleting the singleton itself is absent, not a failed retention trial and cannot recover/validate that class.
definitions.taxonomy: Original custom distance/average linkage/k4 unchanged; no k3 retuning.
